principle: Translate Danny's Photoshop sketches into seven unmistakably different spatial events behind the isolated Infinity subject. Preserve the light background, the five-star PDE-002 portrait surface, and fixed subject geometry. This is a concept-discovery round: every event must be legible at mobile review size, even if it later needs restraint.

recipes.name: Deep number field
recipes.description: Individual Brandon Grotesque digits occupy several depths and slowly recede toward a vanishing area, placing the subject ahead of a moving numerical space.

recipes.name: Side-entering numbers
recipes.description: Single digits enter from both side edges, pass behind the subject, and diminish into depth instead of behaving like a flat typographic wallpaper.

recipes.name: Evasive number corridor
recipes.description: Larger digits travel on curved side corridors and disappear behind the isolated figure, making the pose seem to evade their paths without moving the person.

recipes.name: Moving gradient curtain
recipes.description: A broad, low-contrast tonal curtain crosses the light field behind the subject, testing whether a Lightroom-like gradient can become spatial rather than decorative.

recipes.name: Sliding panel
recipes.description: A distinct vertical edge carries a quiet two-dimensional panel across the background and back, like a restrained sliding door.

recipes.name: Hinged perspective door
recipes.description: A background plane remains hinged to the left edge while its far edge contracts in perspective, opening away from the viewer as in Danny's quadrilateral sketch.

recipes.name: Number doorway
recipes.description: Two perspective panels open to reveal a receding field of individual digits, combining the door and numerical-space ideas as one legible event.
